entries.description: there is no deity except Him
entries.subject: there

spans.text: [20:1] طه Taha Ta, Ha [20:2] مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed [20:3] إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] [20:4] تَنزِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens [20:5] ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established [20:6] لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil [20:7] وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden [20:8] ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna Allah - there is no deity except Him.

entries.description: There is no deity except Me
entries.subject: There

spans.text: There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance [20:15] إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives [20:16] فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish [20:17] وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa And what is that in your right hand, O Moses [20:18] قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses [20:19] قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ Qala alqiha ya moosa [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses [20:20] فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٞ تَسۡعَىٰ Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly [20:21] قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition [20:22] وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign [20:23] لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs [20:24] ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha Go to Pharaoh.

there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.'

entries.subject: And We
entries.object: you] when your sister went and said

spans.text: And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye [20:40] إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّـٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٖ يَٰمُوسَىٰ Ith tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAala man yakfuluhu farajaAAnaka ila ommika kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alghammi wafatannaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAala qadarin ya moosa [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?'

There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance [20:15] إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives [20:16] فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish [20:17] وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa And what is that in your right hand, O Moses [20:18] قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra He said, "It is my staff; We will return it to its former condition [20:22] وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign [20:23] لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs [20:24] ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha Go to Pharaoh.

[20:1] طه Taha Ta, Ha [20:2] مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed [20:3] إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] [20:4] تَنزِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens [20:5] ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established [20:6] لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil [20:7] وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden [20:8] ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna Allah - there is no deity except Him.

I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses [20:19] قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ Qala alqiha ya moosa [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses [20:20] فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٞ تَسۡعَىٰ Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly [20:21] قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition [20:22] وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign [20:23] لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs [20:24] ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha Go to Pharaoh.

Indeed, he has transgressed [20:25] قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي Qala rabbi ishrah lee sadree [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] [20:26] وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي Wayassir lee amree And ease for me my task [20:27] وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee And untie the knot from my tongue [20:28] يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي Yafqahoo qawlee That they may understand my speech [20:29] وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرٗا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee And appoint for me a minister from my family [20:30] هَٰرُونَ أَخِي Haroona akhee Aaron, my brother [20:31] ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي Oshdud bihi azree Increase through him my strength [20:32] وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي Waashrikhu fee amree And let him share my task [20:33] كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرٗا Kay nusabbihaka katheeran That we may exalt You much [20:34] وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا Wanathkuraka katheeran And remember You much [20:35] إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرٗا Innaka kunta bina baseeran Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing [20:36] قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ Qala qad ooteeta sulaka ya moosa [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses [20:37] وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ Walaqad mananna AAalayka marratan okhra And We had already conferred favor upon you another time [20:38] إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ Ith awhayna ila ommika ma yooha When We inspired to your mother what We inspired [20:39] أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوّٞ لِّي وَعَدُوّٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةٗ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.'
